description: Purpose of this region: documents of the organisation — where they live, what they cover, and which version is current.
content:
This region keeps track of documents and their state.

Belongs here: what a document covers, where it is stored, who maintains it, which version is authoritative, and what changed in it. A document itself may be attached to an entry when it has no better home.

Does not belong here: the decision a document records (scope.org_decisions), or content pages of the website, which live in the CMS rather than in memory.
